details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1972-1975, 2009-2012 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The claude_pool_daily_usage job checks out the caller's ref and runs scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh send (and the sourced tg_helpers.sh) from that tree while holding TG_BOT_SECRET, instead of using the verified .codex-workflow-src support checkout the poll job uses.
  WHY: A workflow_dispatch on a non-default branch runs branch-controlled code with the Telegram secret in scope. Severity disagreement: BLOCKER (gemini, luna, qwen) vs NIT (sonnet-5_5 and glm, who note that a writer can already exfiltrate secrets and rate the impact low). The highest severity is used, mapped to critical.
- scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:101-114 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When claude_engine.py pool-usage fails, stderr is discarded (2>/dev/null) and no warning is logged. The script sends the "probe results unreadable" fallback, logs outcome=sent, and saves the day's marker.
  WHY: Operators cannot tell from the Actions log why the report failed, and the failure self-silences for the day. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini) vs NIT (sonnet-5_5, qwen, glm). The highest severity is used, mapped to medium.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:2014-2018 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The "Write today's Claude pool daily usage marker" step lacks set -euo pipefail.
  WHY: If mkdir or date fails, the marker is not saved but the workflow continues as success, so the report re-sends on every tick. Sonnet-5_5 judged this NONE because GitHub's default bash -e shell already stops on failure. Glm listed it only as a hardening suggestion.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:claude_pool_daily_usage job | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The job has no explicit permissions block.
  WHY: The claude-pool-token action needs id-token: write, so the probe may fail. Glm judged this a false positive because the caller internal-orchestrate-poll.yml:8-14 grants id-token: write.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:900-905 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The condition `if rejected and (known is None or known < gate)` in pool_usage_report is claimed to keep the reset time off windows at or above the gate that are not rejected.
  WHY: This is claimed to contradict the stated requirement. Sonnet-5_5, qwen and glm refuted it, because _window_summary at scripts/claude_engine.py:802-803 already appends the reset time for every window at or above the gate.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
(No task gaps reported.)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:~1972-1975, ~2012 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The job checks out the caller's ref and runs scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh and ./.github/actions/claude-pool-token from that tree with TG_BOT_SECRET in scope. The poll job uses .codex-workflow-src.
  WHY: A workflow_dispatch on a branch runs the branch's copy of those files. This is only a trust-boundary inconsistency with low impact.
- scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:daily_usage_send (else branch of pool-usage) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A pool-usage failure is silent in the log. The fallback text is sent, the log prints outcome=sent, and the marker is saved.
  WHY: This is an observability gap only, because the Telegram message does say "probe results unreadable".
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: add a ::warning:: line before the fallback text in daily_usage_send. Also truncate text with `text="${text:0:3900}"` before tg_send_report_msg, because a message over 4096 characters would be rejected and retried every tick. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- Reviewed and found no issue: the reset-time logic in scripts/claude_engine.py, concurrency, the marker step without set -euo pipefail, and the missing check on steps.claude_pool.outcome. There are no task gaps.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:jobs.claude_pool_daily_usage.steps[0] | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The job checks out the triggering ref with actions/checkout@v5, without pinning to a trusted branch.
  WHY: A manual workflow_dispatch on a non-default branch lets branch-controlled code exfiltrate TG_BOT_SECRET.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:jobs.claude_pool_daily_usage | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The job lacks an explicit permissions block.
  WHY: The claude-pool-token action requires id-token: write, so the probe may fail if the default permissions are insufficient.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:jobs.claude_pool_daily_usage.steps["Write today's Claude pool daily usage marker"] | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The step lacks error handling (set -euo pipefail).
  WHY: If mkdir or date fails, the marker is not saved but the workflow continues as success, so the report re-sends on every tick.
- scripts/claude_engine.py:900-905 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The reset-time append logic in pool_usage_report (the `if rejected and (known is None or known < gate)` condition) appears flawed.
  WHY: It keeps the reset time off windows at or above the gate that are not rejected, which contradicts the stated requirement.
- scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:~105 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When claude_engine.py pool-usage fails, stderr is discarded (2>/dev/null) and no warning is logged.
  WHY: The script reports outcome=sent and saves the marker even though no report was built, which leaves no failure signal.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1972-1975, 2009-2012 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The report job runs repository code from the caller-selected ref in a job holding the Telegram bot secret. The script also sources tg_helpers.sh at lines 81-84.
  WHY: internal-orchestrate-poll.yml supports workflow_dispatch, inherits secrets, and calls this workflow at @main. A dispatch on a non-default branch checks out that branch, so its modified script or helper can exfiltrate TG_BOT_SECRET.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: NONE. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 0
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1972-1975, 2012 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The job checks out the repository without a ref: pin, then runs bash scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh send from that checkout with TG_BOT_SECRET in the environment (line 2009). Both wrapper workflows declare workflow_dispatch, so a collaborator can dispatch on any branch. That branch's scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh and the sourced tg_helpers.sh then run with the secret.
  WHY: A malicious branch can replace the script to exfiltrate TG_BOT_SECRET. The poll job avoids this by running scripts from .codex-workflow-src/. Suggested fix: pin the checkout to the default branch, or run .codex-workflow-src/scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh send.
- scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:101 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When claude_engine.py pool-usage fails, stderr is discarded (2>/dev/null) and no warning is logged. The step falls back to the "probe results unreadable" text, reports outcome=sent, and saves the marker.
  WHY: An operator cannot distinguish a legitimate empty pool from a broken Python script, and the saved marker prevents a retry until the next day. Suggested fix: add an ::warning:: echo in the else branch.
- Task completeness: none. The requirement that reset times appear for windows at or above gate_utilization is satisfied by _window_summary at scripts/claude_engine.py:802-803. The gemini pass-1 finding misread the extra append at line 903.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/claude_pool_daily_usage.sh:105-114 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When claude_engine.py pool-usage fails, stderr is discarded and no warning is emitted. The step falls back to the hardcoded "probe results unreadable" text, records outcome=sent, and the job saves the marker.
  WHY: The failure is indistinguishable in the log from a healthy send and self-silences for the day.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1967-1971, 2012 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The report job runs the report script from the caller-ref checkout in a job holding TG_BOT_SECRET and inherited id-token: write. Other credential-bearing steps run from the verified .codex-workflow-src checkout (for example line 1140 and the claude-pool-token call at lines 1055-1065).
  WHY: Exploitation needs write access and is not a privilege escalation, since a writer can already exfiltrate secrets through a self-authored dispatched workflow. It does break the repo's execution-source invariant, and a future pull_request or repository_dispatch trigger would inherit the unsafe shape.
- Verified false positives: the reset-time finding (_window_summary at lines 797-804 handles windows at or above the gate; the rejected clause at lines 914-915 covers only the case with no window reading) and the permissions finding (the caller internal-orchestrate-poll.yml:8-14 grants id-token: write). The concurrency review found no issue, and there are no task gaps.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: (1) add a ::warning:: line before the fallback assignment in the daily_usage_send else branch (lines 105-114); (2) truncate text to about 3900 characters before the tg_send_report_msg call; (3) add set -euo pipefail to the "Write today's Claude pool daily usage marker" step (lines 2014-2018). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
